set_text.text: Par settles to whole cases, but a supplier who sells by the layer or the pallet rounds the order again. Check that the rounding does not leave the line over par every cycle.
Where VOS fits around a par level
Orders arrive line by line, on your own SKUs

VOS does not set par levels, count your stock or buy from your suppliers. Par is set line by line, and that is how orders reach you. Your customers order by voice in the VOS app from guides tied to your SKUs.
Each account's guide carries the prices you set
Catalog updates as stock levels change
Orders arrive confirmed, in the format you use
Additive to your ERP, with nothing to rip out
What to run after a par level
Par says how far to top up. These free calculators answer when the order goes in, how big the reserve should be, and what holding it all costs.
